title: Bakken: the Williston system in and out on one page
dek: A one-way export system with two Enbridge doors. Supply is 1,233 kb/d in the latest snapshot and crude inflows are nil. Door 1 delivers at Clearbrook, the pricing point. Door 2 injects at Cromer, the apportionment gauge, and those barrels ride Line 65 down to the same Clearbrook price. The balance closes on calendar 2025: Dakota Access delivered 536 kb/d at Patoka, the Enbridge ND system delivered 219 at Clearbrook, Bakken North about 25 into Cromer against 145 of filed nameplate, the Guernsey door 215 basin-attributed, rail 143 on the year, Saskatchewan Bakken about 21 via Westspur, and Mandan refines 72 at capacity: total out 1,231 against supply of 1,253, leaving about +22 of stock change and measurement difference, not storage.
